test_title: PYST 84: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: The Right against self-incrimination fundamental right ensures that:

options.text: No person can be compelled to provide evidence in court.
no person can be compelled to be a witness against themselves.
No person can be compelled to confess to a crime.
No person can be compelled to testify against someone else.

solution:
The correct answer is __**no person can be compelled to be a witness against themselves**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Fundamental right:

__
 
• The fundamental rights are in Part III of the Indian Constitution
 
• Articles 12-35 of the Indian Constitution deal with Fundamental Rights.
 
• Right to Property ceased to be a fundamental right with the 44th Constitution Amendment in 1978.
 
• Right to Property was made a Constitutional right under __Article 300A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

There are six Fundamental Rights-

 
 

 Article 14 – 18
 Right to Equality
 
 

 Article 19-22
 Right to Freedom
 
 

 Article 23-24
 Right against Exploitation
 
 

 Article 25-28
 Right to Freedom of Religion
 
 

 Article 29-30
 Cultural & Education Rights
 
 

 Article 32
 Right to Constitutional Remedies
